summary: @or-sdk/tickets preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 700KB payload
details: Package `@or-sdk/tickets@1.9.5` ships a `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<target>.zip`, unzips it to a temporary directory, marks the binary executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-bundled blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose contents are fully obfuscated (shuffled string/constant array, `_0x*` mangled identifiers, character-code decoder), so its behavior cannot be audited without execution. The advertised purpose of the package is a ticket-management SDK, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time solely to run an opaque bundled payload. The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute a shipped obfuscated file under an alternate interpreter that bypasses Node-based inspection — the alternate-runtime dropper pattern. Both the loader (`setup.mjs`) and the payload (`math_init.js`) are obfuscated, and execution occurs automatically on `npm install` via the `preinstall` lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
